# scripts/ops/Test-AvdLandingZoneReadiness.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Preflight for the AVD landing zone, in two stages: -PreDeployment   before deploying: is this subscription and tenant ready for the landing zone described by the parameter file? (default)        after deploying: is the landing zone ready for session hosts and users, including the three post-deployment tenant steps? Check mode by default; -Fix remediates what it can.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-PreDeployment` | switch | yes, in the PreDeployment set |  | ---- Pre-deployment ---- |
| `-ParameterFile` | string | yes, in the PreDeployment set |  |  |
| `-UsersGroup` | string | yes, in the PreDeployment set |  | Entra security group name or object ID. With -Fix, a missing group (by name) is created. |
| `-AdminsGroup` | string | yes, in the PreDeployment set |  |  |
| `-Location` | string | no |  | Region to check and deploy to, instead of the parameter file's default (e.g. from the deployment portal). |
| `-AddMeToGroups` | switch | no |  | Add the signed-in user to both groups (the desktop, plus admin sign-in to the hosts). |
| `-MaxSessionLimit` | int | no |  | Desired sizing (from the deployment portal's sizing step): overrides the parameter file for the checks and the cost estimate, the way deploy.sh --max-sessions / --profile-quota do for the deployment. |
| `-ProfileShareQuotaGiB` | int | no |  |  |
| `-ActiveHoursPerWeek` | int | no | `50` | Hours per week each host runs, for the cost estimate. The deployment portal's Cost step works it out from the working hours and the two power settings below. |
| `-AutoShutdownTime` | string | no |  | Power settings (the portal's Cost step; deploy.sh --auto-shutdown / --start-vm-on-connect): the daily scheduled stop (HH:mm, or none) and Start VM on Connect. Empty = the parameter file's. |
| `-StartVmOnConnect` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Jumpbox` | switch | no |  | The operator jumpbox (deploy.sh --jumpbox / --jumpbox-keep-running, decision 0019): check its region and size, and price it. |
| `-JumpboxOs` | string | no |  |  |
| `-JumpboxKeepRunningUntil` | string | no |  |  |
| `-NamePrefix` | string | yes, in the PostDeployment set |  | ---- Post-deployment ---- |
| `-Environment` | string | yes, in the PostDeployment set |  |  |
| `-SessionHostVmSize` | string | no |  | Size and count to check quota for. Before deployment they override the parameter file (deploy.sh --vm-size / --hosts); after it, the size defaults to the deployed hosts' size. |
| `-SessionHostCount` | int | no | `1` |  |
| `-NtfsHostName` | string | no |  | NTFS check: pick the host, or allow starting a stopped one (it is stopped again afterwards). |
| `-AllowHostStart` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-SkipNtfs` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-WellArchitected` | switch | no |  | Review the deployed landing zone against the Well-Architected Framework (warnings only). |
| `-SkipPSRule` | switch | no |  | With -WellArchitected: skip PSRule for Azure on the live resources (it installs a module and takes a minute or two). |
| `-RecoveryLocation` | string | no | `$env:AVD_RECOVERY_LOCATION` | ---- Both ---- Recovery region to check (build/specs/recovery-spec.md). Empty: AVD_RECOVERY_LOCATION, which deploy.sh and the parameter files read. |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Fix` | switch | no |  | Remediate instead of only reporting. |
| `-Force` | switch | no |  | Skip the per-policy confirmation for Conditional Access changes when fixing. |
| `-SkipTenant` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-PassThru` | switch | no |  | Return the result objects instead of setting an exit code. |
